text:
sasha: Quick heads-up: running a focused least-priv sweep this week targeting legacy org-admins in Payments + Analytics. Want to avoid breaking KMS decrypts for billing workflows. Short plan below, ping if you see gaps.

devon: +1. Which service accounts are in-scope? Any special cases?

sasha: In-scope: svcacct-billing, svcacct-analytics-ingest, svcacct-reports. Special case: svcacct-billing currently relies on org-admin for key access. We'll create a narrow key-binding first.

maria: I can create a dedicated key IAM binding: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/billing/cryptoKeys/billing-wrap-key and attach cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter role to svcacct-billing. Confirmed?

sasha: Yep. Instead of rekeying, we'll add that binding and test impersonated decrypts, then drop the org-admin role.

aj: Canary & rollback plan? If decrypt errors spike, how do we revert quickly?

sasha: Canary: deploy to staging, then enable for 5% of prod jobs behind the feature-flag redwood.kms_sweep.canary. Monitor decrypt error rate + job failures for 12 hours. Rollback: run scripts/revert-iam.sh which re-applies previous org-admin grants. Full steps in the runbook.

devon: I'll add an impersonation test harness to CI: kms-impersonate-decrypt that runs using workload identity impersonation for each svcacct. PR by tomorrow. If CI fails, we don't merge.

access-scan-bot: Scan result 2024-06-24: orphaned org-admin grants found: 9. svcacct-billing flagged as "indirect KMS access via org-admin". Details: /security/scans/17356

sasha: Good signal. Action items: 
- maria: create billing-wrap-key binding + enable principal logging on the key (by EOD)
- devon: add kms-impersonate-decrypt CI job (PR by EOD)
- lee: update incident playbook with revert-iam.sh and pager thresholds
- aj: prepare oncall coverage for the canary window and alert channels (#incidents)

maria: quick Q: do we enable key access logs to Splunk or to the existing audit sink? I prefer Splunk for faster paging.

lee: Splunk is fine for decrypt events. Make sure the sink includes protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp.

aj: Suggested alerts:
- alert when Decrypt RPC errors > 0.5% over baseline for 5m
- alert when billing job failures increase > 3% over 15m

devon: Also add a smoke task that decrypts a small token during the rollout as a canary check. If smoke fails, automation flips the feature flag off.

sasha: Will wire that into the rollout pipeline. One more: double-check KMS condition bindings don't accidentally grant broader access (principals: serviceAccount:svcacct-billing@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com). Use exact principal match, no wildcards.

maria: noted, will use exact principal. Also enabling key's "requireAuthenticationContext" is not needed for this sweep.

incidents-bot: Scheduled window: 2024-07-10T04:00Z - 2024-07-10T08:00Z. Pager will trigger if alerts fire.

sasha: I'll open the RBAC PR with incremental removal (+ canary gating) and tag @devon @maria @lee for review. Will paste the runbook and revert commands in the PR description.

devon: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: will post keybinding command in the PR.

aj: Oncall ready.

sasha: Thanks all — proceeding unless someone raises a blocker by EOD.
__notes: Slack thread: coordination for periodic least-privilege admin sweep with KMS binding changes, CI impersonation tests, Splunk audit logging, canary feature-flag rollout, and revert script. Messages are concise and sequential.
